title: What are the tops of these four row pyramids?
description: The tops of three pyramids with four rows are found without building them, using the rule eigh plus three bee plus three see plus dee. The bottom rows are eight, nineteen, twenty one and thirteen, then seven, eighteen, nineteen and six, then nine, seven, five and eleven.
teaching_notes: One idea: the top of a four row pyramid counts the two end numbers once and the two middle numbers three times each. Watch for students who count the middle numbers only twice, as in a three row pyramid.

video_script.why: The child finds the top of three four row pyramids from their bottom rows without building them, using the letter rule built in the same way as in the solved example.
video_script.substitution: Put the end numbers once and the two middle numbers three times each into eigh plus three bee plus three see plus dee.
video_script.anchor: three bottom row cards, 8 19 21 13 and 7 18 19 6 and 9 7 5 11
video_script.payoff_line: The tops are one hundred forty one, one hundred twenty four and fifty six.

final_answer.spoken: the tops are one hundred forty one, one hundred twenty four and fifty six

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the top of each pyramid.
<bookmark mark='put'/>Step one, in the first row, three times nineteen is fifty seven. Three times twenty one is sixty three.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Eight plus fifty seven plus sixty three plus thirteen is one hundred forty one.
<bookmark mark='put'/>Step two, in the second row, three times eighteen is fifty four. Three times nineteen is fifty seven.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Seven plus fifty four plus fifty seven plus six is one hundred twenty four.
<bookmark mark='put'/>Step three, in the third row, three times seven is twenty one. Three times five is fifteen.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Nine plus twenty one plus fifteen plus eleven is fifty six.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The tops are one hundred forty one, one hundred twenty four and fifty six.
